description: Checks whether Energieausweis Express can issue a Verbrauchsausweis (consumption-based energy certificate) for a residential building in Germany, before any order exists. Returns yes or no with the reason in German (including the rule for houses with a Bauantrag before 1 November 1977 and the change on 1 January 2027), the all-inclusive price, the delivery time and what is needed. Changes nothing.

modernised.description: parts of the envelope renewed since construction: dach (roof or top floor ceiling insulated), aussenwand, fenster, kellerdecke

purpose.description: what the certificate is for: verkauf (sale), vermietung (letting), verlaengerung (lease extension), aushang (display or own records)

residential_only.description: true if the building is used for housing only; false if it also has shops, offices or practices

units.description: number of flats (Wohnungen) in the whole building, if known

year_built.description: year the building was built (Baujahr), if known

name: check_eligibility
title: Check eligibility and price
